description: Label the merged change request with the outcome of its apply

env.help: Token allowed to edit labels on the repository's change requests. Unset, the hook warns instead of labeling.
env.name: PIPELINES_HOOK_APPLY_LABELS_TOKEN

flags.help: Label for a change request whose apply succeeded.
flags.name: success-label

flags.help: Color of the success label as #rrggbb.
flags.name: success-label-color

flags.help: Label for a change request whose apply failed.
flags.name: failure-label

flags.help: Color of the failure label as #rrggbb.
flags.name: failure-label-color

flags.help: Log verbosity. A more verbose PIPELINES_LOG_LEVEL overrides it. One of: trace,debug,info,warning,error,fatal,panic.
flags.name: log-level

name: apply-labels
title: Apply Labels
